reviewedMappings.2014-3-37:0: Source explains superposition of tilted but non-overturned strata. Under the standard schematic-map assumption of no overturned beds, restore southeast-dipping B,C,D to horizontal: B below C below D. D is not oldest, so ㄹ false. No universal assertion that map position alone determines age.
